dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge curve following a non-linear spline from the posterior ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius at the terminal point of the fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin measured at approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.1:1 ratio between the maximum pixel base width and vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Prominent convex melon with a consistent arc radius across the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick rostrum with a high thickness-to-length pixel ratio extending from the cranial base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Sharp interior angle of approximately 130 degrees at the inflection point where the melon meets the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple light-colored linear rake marks visible on the lateral flank below the dorsal fin and near the ocular region.
other_distinctive_markers: Strongly demarcated dark dorsal cape pigmentation contrasting with lighter grey lateral surfaces.
